content.title: Inflation Parameter Change - Let the Rewards begin
content.description:
The swap grace period is over, it's time to enable inflation so that onchain rewards begin.  This proposal is a signal to start our rewards and that most users have gone through the swap.
  The following parameter changes in this proposal are:
  Inflation Min:  5%
 Inflation Max 15%
 Goal Bonded: 25%
 Inflation Change Rate: 2.
 This values are temporary until we stop supporting the old chain and decide how many coins we will burn from the current 400M supply.
  Vote Yes to pass these changes. 
 No to reject the changes

content.title: Limit BZE Max Supply to 400M
content.description: If this proposal passes, the BZE Alpha Team will introduce a maximum supply of 400,000,000 BZE on the BeeZee blockchain. Once this cap is reached, the blockchain will halt the minting of new coins until some are burned. When coins are burned, minting will resume, but only up to the maximum supply limit. Furthermore, the mechanism for resuming minting after reaching the max supply will be adjustable through governance proposals, ensuring full community control over this process.

content.title: V8 Upgrade
content.description:
## Upgraded Cosmos SDK to 0.50 and IBC to v8

## Extended Burner module
- Burner can now burn factory tokens
- IBC coins are exchanged to BZE if they have a liquidity pool with enough liquidity, and the resulting BZE is burned
- Liquidity pool shares are locked in the blackhole address

## Extended Tradebin module
- Added liquidity pools using the constant product formula
- Granted the minter role to the Tradebin module for LP share minting

## Added TX Fee Collector module
- Allows users to pay transaction fees in any denomination that has a liquidity pool with BZE
- Exchanges fees collected in other denominations to BZE and distributes them to delegators

## Rewards module
- Migrated 75,000 BZE (75000000000 ubze) from the Rewards module account to the Community Pool. This amount was accumulated during the creation of three staking rewards and, due to a bug, was never sent to the Community Pool as intended.

## Removed module
- Removed the unused Scavenge module

proposals.title: Fund Liquidity Pools
proposals.summary:
### Fund BZE Liquidity Pools

If this proposal passes, we will spend 3M BZE from the community pool to improve liquidity on BeeZee DEX.

#### Funds usage
- appx. 1,200,000 BZE will be paired with 2,000 USDC for BZE/USDC LP
- 250,000 BZE will be added to BZE/VDL LP and the resulted shares will be locked forever
- 250,000 BZE will be used for infrastructure costs
- 500,000 BZE will be paid to BZE Alpha Team for the 2,000 USDC contribution to BZE/USDC LP. The entire amount will be staked.
- The remaining amount (appx. 800,000 BZE) is a reserve of funds for immediate usage and will be used for the upcoming liquidity pools and monthly costs with the Community Team.

proposals.title: Upgrade network to v8.1.0
proposals.summary:
If passed, this proposal will upgrade the blockchain to version 8.1.0. # v8.1.0 Upgrade Summary

This upgrade removes the `crisis` module, updates dependencies, improves fee handling, and introduces bounded EndBlock queue processing in several modules for better safety and performance.

## Module Highlights

- **Burner**: moved burning and raffle cleanup to bounded EndBlock processing, improved IBC burn/liquidity handling, and tightened raffle protections.
- **Epochs**: added safer epoch lookup with proper error handling.
- **CoinTrunk**: improved validation and fixed article ID pointer update behavior.
- **Rewards**: moved reward processing to bounded EndBlock queues, added anti-spam gas protection, and fixed multiple reward accounting issues.
- **TokenFactory**: tightened subdenom validation and routed creation fees through the fee collection flow.
- **TradeBin**: introduced governance-tunable queue/gas parameters, improved order queue safety, migrated fee params to `sdk.Coin`, and enhanced liquidity and validation checks.
- **TxFeeCollector**: added governance-controlled minimum gas fee and balance iteration limits, and moved fee conversion to EndBlock with split distribution.

## Full Release Notes

Full release notes: https://github.com/bze-alphateam/bze/releases/tag/v8.1.0
